representation: Three tens coupled by one rank-three 3x4 Yukawa Y to four antifives. A single heavy five has mass column m+c*v*lambda with c_d=2 and c_e=-3. Complex conjugation of a row is understood in defining its unit null-complement vector.
relative_sector_scalar_k: At tree level with one common light doublet k=1; independently admitted generalization gives E=k D (I+(rho-1) vv*) up to unmeasured right unitaries.
finite_scope: At the matching point keep the leading dimension-four light Yukawas. Common scale factor v is extracted. SM MS-bar extrapolation; separate SUSY and heavy threshold corrections are not provided or fitted.
